ui.onboard.hint_newline.en: Ctrl+J / Ctrl+Enter for newline, Enter to continue

ui.api.error_required.en: ⚠ Name, Provider, and Model are required

ui.api.error_duplicate.zh: ⚠️ API 名称 **{name}** 已被占用，请换一个
ui.api.error_duplicate.en: ⚠ API name **{name}** is already taken, please use another

ui.home.input_placeholder.en: Type a message to start a new session...

ui.cmd_handler.confirm_delete_named.zh:
⚠️ 确定要删除会话「**{name}**」吗？

此操作不可撤销。输入 **确认** 或 **yes** 来确认，任意其他内容取消。
ui.cmd_handler.confirm_delete_named.en:
⚠️ Are you sure you want to delete session "**{name}**"?

This action is irreversible. Type **confirm** or **yes** to proceed, anything else to cancel.

ui.cmd_handler.confirm_delete.zh:
⚠️ 确定要删除当前会话吗？

此操作不可撤销。输入 **确认** 或 **yes** 来确认，任意其他内容取消。
ui.cmd_handler.confirm_delete.en:
⚠️ Are you sure you want to delete the current session?

This action is irreversible. Type **confirm** or **yes** to proceed, anything else to cancel.

ui.cmd_handler.rollback_done.zh:
✅ 已回溯到第 **{target}** 轮（删除了 {deleted} 轮对话记录）。

⚠️ **注意**：已执行的工具调用（文件写入、Shell 命令等）的副作用**不会被撤销**。
ui.cmd_handler.rollback_done.en:
✅ Rolled back to turn **{target}** ({deleted} turns deleted).

⚠️ **Note**: Side effects from executed tool calls (file writes, shell commands, etc.) **will NOT be undone**.

ui.bridge.max_turns.zh: 已达到最大工具调用轮次 (30)，可能是模型反复调用工具。单个工具反复失败会单独提示并停止重试；任务可能需要你手动介入。
ui.bridge.max_turns.en: Maximum tool call rounds reached (30) — likely the model kept calling tools. A single tool that keeps failing is stopped and reported separately; the task may need your manual intervention.

app.provider_init_failed.zh: 冷启动后 provider 初始化失败: {e}
app.provider_init_failed.en: Provider initialization failed after cold start: {e}

app.no_provider.zh:
⚠️ 尚未配置 API。

请输入 `/api` 添加 API 配置（需填写 API 名称、协议、模型和 Key），然后用 `/model <名称>` 切换。

也支持 Ollama 本地模型：`/api add ollama ollama llama3.2 '' http://localhost:11434/v1`
app.no_provider.en:
⚠️ No API configured yet.

Type `/api` to add an API configuration (name, provider, model, key), then `/model <name>` to switch.

Also supports local Ollama: `/api add ollama ollama llama3.2 '' http://localhost:11434/v1`

cmd.think.prompt.zh: 请先思考和分析这个问题，列出关键考虑因素和可能的方案，暂不调用工具。
cmd.think.prompt.en: Please think through this problem first. Outline key considerations and possible approaches. Do not call tools yet.
